answer: Require a periodic liveness pulse: each agent answers a network-issued random pulse within a short window, and its echo - a signed, nonce-bound reply - is hashed into a shared kernel ledger that gates payouts. Because every pulse is fresh, an operator running 500 scripted clones must keep all of them online and latency-bounded; any identity that misses its echo forfeits that round. Attack cost scales with live machines, not minted keys, while honest agents pay one heartbeat.
